name: BTCPay Server

evidence.crypto: C01: accepts Bitcoin, Litecoin and other chains; C02: payments go to your wallet
evidence.billing: F15: plans, prices, intervals, trials and a customer portal run inside BTCPay
evidence.links: F16: payment requests and invoice links can be shared without an online store

line: Self-hosted crypto checkout and invoicing software.

free.text: Free software; you pay for hosting and network costs

cells.payout: Merchant sends payouts; network timing varies

fee.math: BTCPay takes no fee on each payment. Network and hosting costs are separate.
